skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to collect images from a directory and assemble them into a Word (.docx) document — one image per page — with optional ruled writing lines at the bottom of each page. Trigger phrases include: "把图片放到 Word 文档", "图片合并到 word", "生成图片文档", "images to docx", "collect images into word".
